title: Quarterly alignment dossier: initiative heatmap, runway scenarios, and 'no-regrets' asks
creator: Jonah Reyes
description:
Purpose: Produce a concise dossier for the upcoming QBR that gives execs and ops leads a single-pane view: an initiative heatmap, three runway scenarios (baseline / constrained / accelerated), and a short ‘no-regrets’ ask ladder. This is an ops-led readout to help SecOps, Infra, and Sales leadership commit to resource envelopes and minimal gating decisions.

Why this is different: Rather than a long roadmap slide deck, this deliverable emphasizes decision points and committed asks with clear fallback plans. It scales across Hosted/Dedicated/Private product lines by mapping initiatives to deployment impact (latency/cost/SLA).

Deliverables: 
- One-page initiative heatmap (priority x confidence) mapping to OKRs and SLO risk buckets.
- Three runway scenarios with estimated cost delta and required headcount/infra actions.
- 'No-regrets' ask ladder (Tier 0: required to maintain baseline; Tier 1: unlocks predictable latency for top-10 customers; Tier 2: accelerates Dedicated capacity features).
- 6-slide executive summary + appendix with linked dashboards and eval artifacts.

Success metrics/OKRs tied to this deliverable: 
- OKR: Reduce 95th percentile generation latency for hosted API by 15% (owner: ENG infra).
- KR: Commit to Dedicated capacity procurement plan to meet Q3 projected demand (owner: Sales + Infra).
- KR: Adoption of two standardized rollout policies by Platform teams (owner: Product).

Audience/stakeholders: Executive leadership (CEO/Head of Product/Head of Infra), Platform & Infra leads, Sales leaders for top accounts, Security/Compliance FYI.

How we will use it in the readout: Present the heatmap + scenario lanes (5 minutes) -> run through no-regrets ask ladder and consequences if not approved (10 minutes) -> Q&A and commit next steps (10 minutes).

Artifacts to produce and where to find them in the packet: See links field below.

Notes on scope: This ticket is scoped to producing the dossier and coordinating stakeholder sign-off. Implementation work (e.g., model quantization, Dedicated SKU procurement) will be split into follow-up ENG tickets after the QBR decisions.
acceptance_criteria: One-page initiative heatmap committed by PM + Infra with annotations linking to OKRs and SLO buckets
Runway scenarios include cost delta estimates and a minimal headcount/infra action list for each lane
No-regrets ask ladder enumerated with clear owners and escalation path
6-slide executive summary exported to Drive and reviewed by at least 3 exec stakeholders
Presentation rehearse completed with ops partner and slide-ready notes for Q&A
